Keeps the captured screenshot in place so the translation cannot drift while you read it. Turn it off to see the live screen behind the boxes.
The bubble is running. Tap it over any app to translate.

How it works: tap the bubble and the app takes one screenshot, reads the text on it, translates it on-device, and paints the translation over the original words. Drag the bubble to move it, hold it to stop. Android will ask permission to capture the screen each time you start — that is a system rule, not a setting.
